svg.title: Estimated current while playing: about 494 mA with RetroAchievements Off and 503 mA with it On, a difference of 9 mA (1.8%), within measurement noise
svg.desc: Two horizontal bars from the 1.0.0 Phase 6 battery runs, estimated from battery-gauge readings: RetroAchievements Off, about 494 mA (standard error 5); RetroAchievements On, tracking Pokemon Emerald's 197 achievements, about 503 mA (standard error 3). Difference +9 mA, +1.8%, standard error 6: within measurement noise. RetroAchievements' per-frame evaluation used a little more CPU, so a small real cost is plausible. Pokemon Emerald's intro loop on mGBA with the lid open and the same settings, Wi-Fi On in both runs, matched 40-minute windows from 80% to 71%, one run each. Not electrical measurements, and not comparable with the 0.5.0 figures, which were measured over a different stretch of battery.
